title: Greek Culinary Culture
summary: Greek: oregano and lemon, rice, olive oil.
origins: Greek cuisine reflects mediterranean geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Olive oil, acid, and herbs carry the plate — meat is often a flavoring, not the bulk.
teaching: Layer olive oil, garlic, lemon, and herbs; char vegetables for smoke without heaviness.
Quality olive oil, lemons, olives, and dried oregano transform simple ingredients.
Signature pairing: oregano and lemon + rice + olive oil.
